about: Renders the state of one set of items against another, with a mark at every crossing. The last column rolls each row up to its worst state.
caption: Service health by region

empty.about: A matrix with no rows renders the `empty` content in one full-width row.
empty.title: An empty matrix

flat.about: Rows without a `group` render in one body. The matrix renders sections only when every row states a group, so rows that state one only in part render flat.
flat.title: Without sections

gap.about: Three services with APAC never run. A crossing with no cell renders the unmeasured mark. The rollup ranks a gap above a pass and a crossing that does not apply, and below a warning, so auth rolls up to Not measured and billing to Down.
gap.title: A gap ranks above a pass

picking.about: With `onSelectCell`, every crossing is a button, a crossing with no cell included, and a press reports the row, the column and the cell. Without it the matrix has no tab stop. The pointer rests on notifications in Reston, and the crosshair fills that row and that column with `bg.subtle`.
picking.title: Picking a crossing

size.about: Every size. The size sets the text, the cell padding and the marks, so it decides how many rows fit on a screen.
size.title: Sizes

title: Status matrix
